rule: Pick sections by running the REAL buildSchedule() AND buildSecondPass() from SQE1_COLP_Revision.html in node against the server done-set (colp_progress.php), then MERGING both passes by date. SEED_DATES are TEACHING dates, not due dates. As at the Aug 2026 rewrite of that file: no MIN_GAP (eligible the day taught), SCHED_END 2027-01-10 (day before FLK1), isFreeDay also excludes four FULL_PAPER_DAYS Sundays, DEFAULT_DONE CONT1.1-1.3. The first pass assigns ONE new module per free day (75 days); buildSecondPass adds ONE spaced revisit per day (83 entries, 21-day gap, coldest first). BOTH COUNT. getStatus() colours cards from the first pass only and revisits render on the existing card - that is display, not scheduling. Taking the first pass alone sends the overhaul to material 2-3 weeks out and skips the oldest never-overhauled chapters, which is what the second pass exists to rescue. Nothing is ever overdue; the queue drains in TEACHING order. Take Today then Upcoming from the MERGED list, skipping sections already done here. Then: (1) pdftotext the SLK manual chapter, (2) rebuild notes terse (15-25k chars, one point per line, citations only in the cases array, grep every case name back against the manual), (3) visuals array - overview mind map + one per topic + decision trees for confusable doctrines (map: 2-5 branches, grid: 2-4 cols), (4) preserve/relocate MCQ traps, never delete, (5) verify with the node buildVis sweep, (6) push the single file via a /tmp clone.

format_spec.rule: Quick refresher for memorisation. Complete sentences, one idea per line, no character caps. Compress by removing empty words, splitting compound lines, saying it once, and pushing detail into collapsed panels - never by truncating.
format_spec.mcq_traps: REMOVED from all sections 2026-08-10 - superseded by the FLASH_DATA deck (244 cards, 243 auto-generated from wrong answers). Backup in removed_mcq_traps_backup.json.
format_spec.decision_trees: Only for a multi-criteria test where every limb must be worked, or a real fork (if X then this, if not-X then that). Never to enumerate.

leaf_rule.why: Ghita on 7.7: 'it talks about 7 duties and does not list them, 3 conditions not mentioned, and things like s184 which i don't know what it means'.
leaf_rule.rule_1: A count never stands in for the content. Name the things. A count is allowed as a BRANCH LABEL only when the leaves beneath it name every item.
leaf_rule.rule_2: Never a bare section number. Rule first, number in square brackets at the end. If you cannot state what the section says in the leaf, it belongs only in the collapsed statutes panel.
leaf_rule.leaf_length: No word cap. The old 3-6 word cap was deleted because it was what forced counts and bare numbers to stand in for content.
leaf_rule.regression_scan: leaves matching \bx\d\b or ^(s|ss|reg|art)\s?\d, and branch labels whose count exceeds the items their leaves name
